_how_to_edit: Paste any YouTube link (or just the 11-character ID) into a video's "link". start is seconds to start at (0 = beginning). mode is "required" (locks that card's quick check until the student opens the video) or "optional". title and note show on the card.

hs-ess1-light/l1.where: Level 1, card 1: Parts of a wave
hs-ess1-light/l1.title: Wave Basics
hs-ess1-light/l1.note: Crest, trough, wavelength, frequency and amplitude, the words you just met.

hs-ess1-light/l2.where: Level 2, card 1: The whole family of light
hs-ess1-light/l2.title: What is the Electromagnetic Spectrum
hs-ess1-light/l2.note: The seven kinds of light, from radio waves to gamma rays.

hs-ess1-light/l3.where: Level 3, card 1: Electrons jump up, then fall back down
hs-ess1-light/l3.title: The Bohr Atom
hs-ess1-light/l3.note: Electrons jumping between energy levels. It goes a little beyond this level.

hs-ess1-light/l4.where: Level 4, card 1: A pattern only one element can make
hs-ess1-light/l4.title: Emission and Absorption Spectra
hs-ess1-light/l4.note: Bright lines, dark lines, and why every element has its own pattern.

hs-ess1-light/l5.title: Doppler Effect
hs-ess1-light/l5.note: Why a moving source changes pitch, the same idea as redshift.
